title: Virtual Screening of Nrf2 Dietary-Derived Agonists and Safety by a New Deep-Learning Model and Verified In Vitro and In Vivo.
authors: Liu, Song; Qin, Huan-Huan; Ji, Xin-Ran; Gan, Jian-Wen; Sun, Meng-Jia; Tao, Jin; Tao, Zhuo-Qi; Zhao, Guang-Nian; Ma, Bing-Xin
journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
one_liner_zh: 该文用深度学习模型虚拟筛选膳食来源的Nrf2激动剂并做体外/体内验证，对象为小分子-蛋白互作，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制，与本课题无关。
abstract: Nuclear factor (erythroid-derived 2)-like 2 (Nrf2) is an essential regulatory target of antioxidants, but the lack of Nrf2 active site information has hindered discovery of new Nrf2 agonists from food-derived compounds by large-scale virtual screening. Two deep-learning models were separately trained to screen for Nrf2-agonists and safety. The trained models screened potentially active chemicals from approximately 70,000 dietary compounds within 5 min. Of the 169 potential Nrf2 agonists identified via deep-learning screening, 137 had not been reported before. Six compounds selected from the new Nrf2 agonists significantly increased (p < 0.05) the activity of Nrf2 on carbon tetrachloride (CCl(4))-intoxicated HepG2 cells (nicotiflorin (99.44 +/- 18.5%), artemetin (97.91 +/- 8.22%), daidzin (87.73 +/- 3.77%), linonin (74.27 +/- 5.73%), sinensetin (72.74 +/- 10.41%), and tectoridin (77.78 +/- 4.80%)), and their safety were demonstrated by an MTT assay. The safety and Nrf2 agonistic activity of nicotiflorin, artemetin, and daidzin were also reconfirm by a single-dose acute oral toxicity study and CCl(4)-intoxicated rat assay.
abstract_zh: 核因子（红细胞衍生2）样2（Nrf2）是抗氧化剂的重要调控靶点，但缺乏Nrf2活性位点信息阻碍了通过大规模虚拟筛选从食物来源化合物中发现新的Nrf2激动剂。分别训练了两个深度学习模型，用于筛选Nrf2激动剂和安全性。训练后的模型在5分钟内从约70,000种膳食化合物中筛选出潜在活性化学物质。通过深度学习筛选鉴定出的169种潜在Nrf2激动剂中，有137种此前未被报道过。从新Nrf2激动剂中选出的六种化合物显著提高了（p < 0.05）四氯化碳（CCl(4)）中毒的HepG2细胞中Nrf2的活性（烟酸花素（nicotiflorin）（99.44 ± 18.5%）、艾草素（artemetin）（97.91 ± 8.22%）、大豆苷（daidzin）（87.73 ± 3.77%）、柠檬苦素（linonin）（74.27 ± 5.73%）、辛弗林素（sinensetin）（72.74 ± 10.41%）和鸢尾苷（tectoridin）（77.78 ± 4.80%）），并通过MTT实验证明了其安全性。烟酸花素、艾草素和大豆苷的安全性和Nrf2激动活性也通过单剂量急性口服毒性研究和CCl(4)中毒大鼠实验得到进一步确认。
